summary: This is a command‑line tool that recreates the co‑op mode of the DOS game Wing Commander, letting multiple players connect over a network. It runs locally without any external API keys and is distributed as source on GitHub. It is aimed at enthusiasts of retro gaming who want to experience multiplayer on modern hardware. The strongest point is that the installation succeeds quickly (16.1 s), but the tool fails basic runtime tests and lacks integration options, limiting its practical use.
